title: Intelligence
description: Curated playlist exploring biological origins, neural computation, cognitive architectures, large language models, compute silicon, and the socio-economics of synthetic intelligence.

clips.title: Chapter 1: When Did Intelligence Begin
clips.notes: Investigates the phylogenetic dawn of intelligence: from cellular chemotaxis and sensory feedback loops to predictive neural modeling.
userQuestions: At what evolutionary juncture does simple stimulus-response cross into genuine intelligence?
userIdeas: Use evolutionary feedback loops as architectural constraints for reinforcement learning agents.

clips.title: The Economics of Artificial Intelligence | Tyler Cowen
clips.notes: Tyler Cowen dissects capital deepening, productivity paradoxes, and the distributional consequences of synthetic cognitive labor.
userQuestions: Will AI increase or decrease the returns to high-variance talent?
userIdeas: Analyze token cost curves in relation to Baumol cost disease in human services.

clips.title: Does intelligence have a basis in genetics? | Manolis Kellis and Lex Fridman
clips.notes: Computational biologist Manolis Kellis explains polygenic score architecture, neural development pathways, and biological plasticity.
userQuestions: How does genetic modularity inform sparse mixture-of-experts in artificial networks?
userIdeas: Map polygenic regulatory networks to hyperparameter optimization strategies.

clips.title: Recurrent Neural Network - The Math of Intelligence
clips.notes: Mathematical derivation of hidden state vector evolution over time, vanishing gradient dynamics, and gating mechanisms (LSTM/GRU).
userQuestions: Why did self-attention supersede recurrence for long temporal sequences?
userIdeas: Benchmark linear RNN state spaces against transformer attention for edge deployment.

clips.title: The Symbiont: Rise of Living Intelligence
clips.notes: Explores human-machine symbiotic intelligence where human intuition and synthetic generative models form an integrated cognitive organ.
userQuestions: How does epistemic agency shift when cognition is co-produced with an AI model?
userIdeas: Design continuous dual-loop interfaces rather than turn-based prompt/response.

clips.title: Open Weight AI Models Explained for Everyone
clips.notes: Comprehensive taxonomy of open weights vs open source: weight tensors, quantization formats (GGUF/AWQ), licensing, and democratized inference.
userQuestions: What are the marginal security implications of distilled open weight models?
userIdeas: Run quantized local weights via llama.cpp alongside cloud reasoning models.

clips.title: I Built an LLM From Scratch
clips.notes: Ground-up PyTorch construction of the nanoGPT transformer architecture: token embeddings, multi-head causal self-attention, and residual blocks.
userQuestions: How do scaling laws govern loss reduction across token counts vs parameter counts?
userIdeas: Implement a lightweight character-level attention toy model for interactive inspection.

clips.title: The Next Generation of Neural Networks | Geoffrey Hinton
clips.notes: Geoffrey Hinton critiques backpropagation biological implausibility and presents vector capsules with coordinate frames and routing-by-agreement.
userQuestions: Can biological forward-forward algorithms eliminate the need for global backprop?
userIdeas: Explore routing-by-agreement mechanisms in multimodal vision encoders.

clips.title: Deep Learning Basics: Introduction and Overview
clips.notes: Foundational masterclass spanning perceptrons, activation functions (ReLU, GELU), computational graphs, SGD momentum, and regularization.
userQuestions: How does overparameterization escape bad local minima in high-dimensional loss landscapes?
userIdeas: Visualize 2D loss surface projections during training convergence.

clips.title: AI Chip Wars: LPUs, TPUs & GPUs w/ Jonathan Ross, Founder Groq
clips.notes: Architecture breakdown of Groqs deterministic Tensor Streaming Processor (LPU) vs Nvidias H100 SIMD/SIMT architectures and HBM memory bottlenecks.
userQuestions: How does SRAM-based deterministic compiler scheduling eliminate cache miss latency?
userIdeas: Calculate real-time conversational latency thresholds for interactive voice synthesis.

clips.title: You Can Learn AI Agent Graph Engineering In 21 Min
clips.notes: Transitioning from linear chains to cyclic directed graph architectures: persistent state machines, human-in-the-loop nodes, and deterministic routers.
userQuestions: How to ensure convergence and eliminate infinite loops in self-reflective multi-agent graphs?
userIdeas: Model playlist transcript extraction pipeline as an autonomous cyclical graph agent.

clips.title: Claude Skills: I Stopped Installing Them. Here's What I Do Instead
clips.notes: Modular skill architecture vs monolithic bloated prompts: progressive context loading, concise instruction design, and task-specific sandbox tools.
userQuestions: What is the token overhead vs execution precision trade-off in dynamic tool schemas?
userIdeas: Integrate the learn-better repository skills as targeted system-level context modules.
